summary.text: Joshua Watkins is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 42 who has served since January 1, 2025, and is running unopposed for re-election on November 3, 2026. He is a government administrator.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he serves as House Minority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Watkins was born in Miami, Florida.
He attended Murray State University, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kentucky in 2010 and a graduate degree from Northcentral University in 2022.

His career experience includes working as a government administrator, community advocate and grassroots organization advisor, and he has been affiliated with Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity, Incorporated, the Waterfront Development Corporation and the Kentucky College of Art & Design.
Watkins succeeded Democrat Keturah Herron in District 42.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Agriculture, House State Government, House Natural Resources and Energy, and Small Business & Information Technology committees.

In his 2026 survey he said he spent more than a decade in community development, local government, project management and public-sector performance, and that his legislative work has focused on housing affordability, healthcare, public safety and economic opportunity.
